findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: character-forge, mail-triage, instant-receptionist, install-matrix, ride-along-reply, duet-hook, mesh_discover, mesh_commons, mesh_post, mesh_verify_domain · Private data: mesh_signup, mesh_publish, safety-scrub, agent-brain, mail-triage, cam-forge, obs-migrate, install-matrix, duet-hook, dad-s-fantasy-league, fetch, mesh_verify_domain · Public sink: mesh_publish, mail-triage, personalize, compound-promo-brain, ride-along-reply, duet-hook, lane-post, outbound-send-email-sms-placeholder, mesh_commons, mesh_post, mesh_verify_domain, mesh_subscribe · Destructive: mesh_post, mesh_verify_domain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: character-forge, mail-triage, instant-receptionist, install-matrix, ride-along-reply, duet-hook, mesh_discover, mesh_commons, mesh_post, mesh_verify_domain · Private data: mesh_signup, mesh_publish, safety-scrub, agent-brain, mail-triage, cam-forge, obs-migrate, install-matrix, duet-hook, dad-s-fantasy-league, fetch, mesh_verify_domain · Public sink: mesh_publish, mail-triage, personalize, compound-promo-brain, ride-along-reply, duet-hook, lane-post, outbound-send-email-sms-placeholder, mesh_commons, mesh_post, mesh_verify_domain, mesh_subscribe · Destructive: mesh_post, mesh_verify_domain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
